name: resume-test
description: Training-resume test: smoke.json data (games reused from sftp-smoke-3), max_examples 320 = 5 updates on 4 x B200, a checkpoint every 2 steps. Run it twice: once uninterrupted, once with the train call cancelled after checkpoint-2 and relaunched with --action resume --retry train; the resumed steps 3-5 must match the uninterrupted run.
